name: ObjectivesTrackedObjective
summary: One element of the tracked and completed objectives maps: a prefix-varint id, a strict zero-or-one presence byte with its optional prefix varint, and one big-endian u64 that the chunk mask declares present. PROVEN LAYOUT, NOT PROVEN MEANINGS: no field's meaning is named by the code, and no live record exists for either member.
purpose: Give the tracked and completed objective maps a named element card so each member body is masked_counted(nested(...)) instead of copying the element layout.

fields.name: id
fields.note: Read by FUN_14087b910 in the 0x143a69460 element loop and stored at element +0x18. The writer 0x142f882a0 writes it with FUN_140877c30. The code names neither the map key nor what it indexes, so the meaning is not established.

fields.name: delta
fields.note: A strict zero-or-one presence byte through FUN_1461adf60 (which rejects any byte above 1) followed by one prefix varint when it is 1. The writer 0x142f882a0 delta-codes it against the previous element and writes the client's -1 sentinel instead; the reader maps the sentinel back to the previous id. No live body shows which value it carries.

fields.name: value
fields.note: Read by FUN_14087af30 (eight raw bytes through the byte-swap FUN_146168b00) only when the chunk mask bit is set; a clear bit creates the entry without it. The writer 0x142f882a0 writes it with FUN_140877280 when the entry's type is below 2. No field is named.

evidence.ref: Element loop of member reader 0x143a69460 (build 30fe6461): id FUN_14087b910, strict presence FUN_1461adf60, masked u64 FUN_14087af30, chunk mask byte 0x14087a330.

Writer 0x142f882a0 is the +0x28 slot of both member vtables 0x148259910 and 0x1482599b0; it writes the same order (id FUN_140877c30, delta FUN_146168410, mask bit and value FUN_140877280) and reserves the chunk mask byte before the elements. Writer and reader agree; no live body exists, so evidence is partial.
